newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM unveils fresh cost-cutting drive.
newsitem.headline: KLM unveils fresh cost-cutting drive.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines on Tuesday said it was launching a new restructuring programme to boost its operating income.
"KLM's commitment to reach a return on equity of 14 percent has prompted us to launch a far-reaching programme to significantly improve operating income," KLM said in a statement.
The Dutch carrier said it would give full details later.
KLM said second quarter operating income had been very disappointing primarily due to escalating fuel prices, a weak, though improving, cargo market, and rising operating expenses other than fuel.
Second quarter operating income fell to 182 million guilders from 333 million a year earlier.
The Dutch carrier said the new programme, Focus 2000, would reduce costs and raise revenues. It also said it aimed to achieve a new, less-complex structure for the company.
